title: Identifier Minting
description: UUIDv7 generation and slug duplication for node identity.
body: Identifier minting. PRD §3.1 makes a node's identity a UUIDv7 and PRD §12.3 requires that a duplicate mint a new UUIDv7 and append a suffix to the slug — a copy is a new thing, never the same thing twice. UUIDv7 rather than v4 because the first 48 bits are the mint time, so a directory of `nodes/<uuid>.json` sorts chronologically without a stored timestamp.
